question: Which ATT&CK tactics do the techniques mapped from CAPEC-13 (Subverting Environment Variable Values) belong to?

answer.headline: Gathered 3 record(s) from 2 source(s); 2 cross-source correlation(s) on shared identifiers.
answer.narrative: The techniques mapped from CAPEC-13 are T1574.006, T1574.007, and T1562.003. The techniques T1574.006 and T1574.007 are associated with the Stealth (TA0005) and Execution (TA0002) tactics, but the evidence does not provide the tactics for T1562.003.
